entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: An ancient species native to the Blind Eternities with no physical form or color alignment, whose ceaseless hunger drives them to devour planes.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan that warps biology; summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri and imprisoned in its moon, and later consumes the Echoverse.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan that warps physical properties; incinerated on Zendikar by Chandra's flame.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan that warps reality; incinerated on Zendikar alongside Ulamog.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A spirit dragon planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar and bound them with colorless magic.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who built the hedron network of the Eldrazi prison on her own Zendikar, and later summoned Emrakul to Innistrad.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who lured the Eldrazi to Zendikar and later allied with Nissa.

entities.name: The Three
entities.description: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri, the planeswalkers who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's plane, chosen as the prison for the Eldrazi for its lush ecosystems and dynamic mana.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A subterranean chamber in the mountains of Akoum where the imprisonment spell was concentrated and sealed with a lock.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Stone structures built by Nahiri that formed the bars of the planewide Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A mountainous region of Zendikar that hides the Eye of Ugin and where cultists devoted to Ulamog arose.

entities.name: Zhulodok
entities.description: An Eldrazi from the first wave to awaken, which razed Akoum and was slain by Nahiri.

entities.name: Vampire bloodchiefs
entities.description: The twelve surviving cultists who became the progenitors of the vampire race.

entities.name: Windblast Gorge
entities.description: A gorge said to have been carved from a mountain range in a single night of feeding by Zhulodok.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose meeting with Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosened the Eldrazi's bonds.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who burns Ulamog and Kozilek through Zendikar's leylines.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath planeswalker who communicated with a conceptualization of Emrakul and planned the titans' killing.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who shattered the main Hedron, releasing the titans, then fought them.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and keeps the Eldrazi swarms from the army.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps clear Eldrazi swarms and tries to persuade Nissa to release the titans.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk who helps the planeswalkers study the leylines.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance sworn by Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace to stand together against threats.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel of Innistrad driven to madness by Emrakul's presence.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane to which Nahiri summoned Emrakul.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A creation of Jace who contacts Emrakul and guides her to the Echoverse.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: An alternate multiverse of unstable planes that Emrakul consumes.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A vampire who had visions while attacking a large Eldrazi.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A general who had a vision of Kozilek obliterating the Gatewatch.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: A plane where the Eldrazi are called elds and have made incursions.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: A faction on the Edge that fought an Eldrazi incursion alongside the Drix.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: A faction on the Edge that remain consummate Eldrazi hunters.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where the Eldrazi are native.

events.summary: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri decide to rid the Multiverse of the Eldrazi; Ugin helps imprison them on Zendikar instead.
events.quote: Ugin told them that it wouldn't be a good idea to destroy them and instead helped them imprison the Eldrazi on the plane of Zendikar.

events.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic and Nahiri's hedron network forms the prison bars.
events.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane, directing their hunger to that unique mana

events.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
events.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

events.summary: Cultists in Akoum, infected by Ulamog's creative force, perform rituals that loosen the prison's bonds.
events.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

events.summary: Zhulodok awakens and razes the land; twelve cultists survive to become the first vampire bloodchiefs.
events.quote: but those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race.

events.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok, and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
events.quote: Even after Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

events.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
events.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

events.summary: Nissa shatters the main Hedron and releases the enchantment imprisoning the titans, and Sorin washes his hands of her.
events.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans.

events.summary: Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace swear an oath to stand together and form the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the Gatewatch was created.

events.summary: Jace plans to kill the titans by binding Kozilek and Ulamog to Zendikar with a leyline pattern, using defenders as bait.
events.quote: Jace decided to slay the titans with the Gatewatch's and Kiora 's help.

events.summary: Chandra channels fire through the leylines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek; Ugin is angered.
events.quote: In one brilliant stroke of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

events.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin; Avacyn and the angels go mad, and Emrakul corrupts inhabitants.
events.quote: She was summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri to take revenge on Sorin, and her presence drove Avacyn and the angels to madness.

events.summary: Emrakul allows herself to be imprisoned in Innistrad's moon.
events.quote: Emrakul allowed herself to be imprisoned in Innistrad's moon for an unknown purpose.

events.summary: Tam contacts Emrakul on Innistrad; Emrakul learns of the Echoverse and demands to be guided to it, frightening Tam.
events.quote: Emrakul demanded that Tam guide her to the Echoverse so she could destroy it

events.summary: Tam, empowered by Jace's spark, calls Emrakul, who separates the Echoverse from the Multiverse and consumes it.
events.quote: dematerialized the latter, pulling it into herself and consuming it.

events.summary: During the Fomori-Eldrazi war on the Edge, the Fomori and Drix fight off an Eldrazi incursion through the Chaos Wall.
events.quote: At the end of the war, the Eldrazi were forced to go into remission.

events.summary: Around 4564 AR several elds attack Infinite Guideline Station when the Endstone is brought there.
events.quote: several eldrazi attacked the station and its occupants.
